problem: Live pricing, package-advisor and portal-demo metadata diverged from their page content after terminal build transforms. Utility pages inherited the Over ons title and pricing exposed an older title.
root_cause: Canonical shell and commercial build stages could rewrite head metadata after the source HTML had already been corrected.
decision: Make the terminal website coherence finalizer authoritative for route-level title, description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter metadata on key public product and conversion routes.
prevention: Key route metadata is asserted after all shell, locale and commercial page transforms.
Page-specific utility routes must never inherit template-page titles.
SEO/social metadata must describe the same proposition visible in the page body.
